italian-reading-6.title: SC sounds
italian-reading-6.subtitle: Distinguish sca, sce, and sche
italian-reading-6.description: Learn to read SC before different vowels and notice the role of H.

ir6-p1.translations: Excuse me, the stairs are here. The scene is beautiful.

ir6-t1.text: sca, sco, scu have the SC sound before A, O, U; sce, sci are read differently.

ir6-t2.text: In sche, schi, H keeps the sound of sca, sco, scu before E and I.

ir6_q1.question: Which combinations have the SC sound before A, O, and U?

ir6_q2.question: Which combinations have the SC sound heard in "scena"?

ir6_q3.question: Which combinations keep the SC sound of scala/scopa before E and I?

ir6_q4.question: Which spelling has the SC sound heard in "scena"?
